pkgmetadata.longdescription: K3s is a fully compliant, lightweight Kubernetes distribution packaged as a single binary. It bundles its own containerd, runc, and CNI plugins, and can run as either a server (control-plane) or an agent node.

use.flag: Install a "kubectl" symlink to the bundled k3s kubectl
Install a "crictl" symlink to the bundled k3s crictl
Install a "ctr" symlink to the bundled k3s ctr
